QTSP continuous window-size and Werner-parameter update.
Main run: one continuous QTSP simulation, updated at each source T_W boundary.
Update rule: W_next = W + gamma * (target_tp - observed_tp).
Update rule: w_next = w + gamma * ((tp_plus - tp_minus) / (w_plus - w_minus)).
Werner plus/minus probes are independent one-window QTSP runs; the main run is not restarted.
Werner parameter is clamped to [1.0e-6, 0.999999].
